headline: Transaction growth offsets a soft freight market
summary_short: Full Truck Alliance's Q2 2026 net revenue rose 4.4% y/y to RMB3,381.6M as transaction-service revenue jumped 33.1% and net income rose 6.3% to RMB1,345.1M.
summary_long: Total net revenues rose 4.4% y/y to RMB3,381.6M (US$498.4M) as transaction service revenue grew 33.1% to RMB1,766.4M, offsetting a decline in freight brokerage revenue. Operating income rose 30.4% to RMB1,486.1M; net income rose 6.3% to RMB1,345.1M (non-GAAP: RMB1,433.8M, +6.0%). Fulfilled orders reached 68.5M (+12.7%) and average shipper MAUs hit 3.57M (+12.8%), with platform fulfillment rate at a record 47%. Free cash flow rose to RMB2,040.0M from RMB1,299.2M. The company declared a quarterly dividend of US$0.0042/share (US$0.0840/ADS, ~US$87.5M total) and guided Q3 2026 net revenues to RMB3.32-3.42bn, roughly flat versus RMB3.36bn a year earlier.

drivers.explanation: Growth driven by increases in order volume, penetration rate, and per-order transaction service fee.
Higher order density and growing trucker capacity drove the fulfillment rate to a record high.
Platform improvements 'significantly improved user satisfaction on both sides,' per management, amid a challenging freight market.
